messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1807501234 - smart-routing-service elevated error rate (pages sent) - paging oncall
tilly: got the page, joining. seeing lots of 502s from router-service at edge clusters in eu-west-1
maria: adding context — we rolled a config-schema change to routing-policies 20m ago that deprecated `fallback_priority` and added `fallback_strategy`. several policies still contain the old field and the schema migration set an implicit default.
aj: omg that default is `region-first` fallback, which bounces requests to nearest region; combined with new weight-based routing it creates a loop when capacity is low.
zoe: impacting customers — two high-traffic tenants show degraded latency and partial failures for generation calls. Support is getting noise.
simon: flagging product impact: chat sessions drop midstream; customers see hallucination-like truncation. we need a clear mitigation and comms.
tilly: quick mitigation idea: flip routing service to conservative fallback (disable automatic region fallback) and force model-variant pin for affected tenants. doing it in prod will take an ACL patch.
aj: agreed. I can push a temporary policy override that sets `fallback_strategy: none` and `max_retries: 1` for the global routing policy.
ops-lead: call it out in incident channel before any global change. we need to coordinate maintenance window if it materially impacts traffic.
maria: posting what we think is the misconfig snippet:
```json
{
  "policy_name": "smart-defaults-v2",
  "fallback_priority": "legacy", // deprecated
  "region_weights": {"eu-west-1": 0.7, "us-east-1": 0.3}
}
```
This ended up being treated as an explicit instruction by the migration step and the implicit default behavior kicked in.
tilly: i'm on it — applying override now. aj do you have the curl to patch?
aj: running:
```bash
curl -X POST https://config.internal/api/v1/policies/override \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CFG_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"policy_name":"smart-defaults-v2","fallback_strategy":"none","max_retries":1}'
```
deploy-bot: PATCH /api/v1/policies/override succeeded (200) - change-id c9f3a2
tilly: rollback in-line tests: quick k6 against a canary tenant — latency looks back to baseline, 502s down 95% for the canary.
zoe: notifying affected customers: sent preliminary message to two tenants, telling them we're investigating and will follow up.
simon: good. prepare short blurb for status page if it stays elevated >30m.
maria: root cause note: our schema migration removed enforcement for `fallback_priority` but populated a migration-time default of `legacy` which our runtime mapped to region-fallback behavior. new runtime logic expected `fallback_strategy`, mismatch led to inadvertent region-first fallbacks.
tilly: next steps: 1) keep override for 2 hours, 2) start a targeted job to rewrite deprecated fields out of stored policies, 3) add a gating check to the config service to reject deprecated fields with a clear migration path.
aj: i'm starting a batch job to rewrite policies: `policy-migrate --from fallback_priority --to fallback_strategy --map legacy=region-weighted,legacy-lowlat=none` — will run in dry-run first.
ops-lead: tilly you're on first responder, aj second, maria will own the migration PR and gating, zoe owns customer comms, simon owns product impact assessment. handoff in 45m — who is next oncall?
tilly: my shift ends in 40m, @maria will take the handoff. maria?
maria: taking handoff. i'll monitor the override and the policy-rewrite dry run. if we see any increase in error % after enabling rewrites we revert.
simon: support asked for an ETA to customers — can we safely say 2-4 hours for full remediation?
maria: yes 2-4 hours assuming no further surprises. we may need to run incremental rewrites per tenant to avoid mass churn.
zoe: ack, sending status update to customers now.
incident-bot: Incident 1807501234 acknowledged by tilly. Paging paused.
tilly: quick note for postmortem — add check: "config migration should not inject defaults that change runtime semantics without a canary gate" and a test that validates runtime mapping of deprecated keys.
aj: also adding an alert for sudden routing fallback churn metrics.
maria: starting the migration PR: https://git.internal/redwood/policies/pull/492 — description & rollback plan included.
deploy-bot: canary patch applied to routing-service in eu-west-1 — 3 instances.
tilly: observed steady state for the past 10m in the canary, rolling to remaining clusters.
zoe: support thread quieting down, no new tickets in the last 15m.
ops-lead: great work. when you hand off, please paste the list of outstanding actions into the incident slack thread and set severity in PagerDuty.
maria: outstanding actions pasted to incident ticket, severity set to Sev2. handing off to @aj at 18:30 UTC.
aj: got it. I'll keep monitoring and escalate if anomaly returns.
incident-bot: Incident 1807501234 status changed to "mitigated" by aj. Auto-reminder set for postmortem in 24h.
tilly: thanks everyone — add any notes to the postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/incidents/1807501234-mitigation-notes
simon: we should also review product routing defaults; scheduling a short sync tomorrow.
zoe: closing customer comms loop after final verification.
mall: :wave: (not a participant, test message)
